products.title: Products
products.intro: Choose a line-up to see every watch in it. Click a watch for full details, specifications and price.
products.mobileIntro: Swipe the tabs to change line-up.
products.behaviour: Tabs filter products.json by 'lineups'. Clicking a card opens the Watch Details popup (desktop) or bottom sheet (mobile).

watchDetails.behaviour: Thumbnail click swaps the main photo; selected thumbnail has a gold border. Lock page scroll while open.

technology.title: Technology
technology.intro: What makes each watch tick: the movements and materials behind every line-up we sell.

prices.title: Price list
prices.intro: Every watch and clock we stock, in one table. Prices in Nigerian naira, VAT included.
prices.footnote: Prices may change, so please confirm in store. Trade-in and instalment plans available.
prices.behaviour: Rows come from products.json. Tabs filter by line-up, search filters name + brand. Row click opens the Watch Details popup.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: Inside our boutique and workshop, and a closer look at the pieces we love.
gallery.behaviour: 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile. Click a tile → full-screen lightbox with ← → arrows, caption and ✕.

storeLocator.title: Store locator
storeLocator.intro: Visit us for repairs, appraisals or to try a watch on. Ten stores across Nigeria, from Lagos and Abuja to Port Harcourt and Kano.
storeLocator.behaviour: Selecting a store highlights it (gold border) and centres the map. 'Use my location' sorts stores by distance using navigator.geolocation.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Repairs, servicing, warranty and answers to common questions.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions about a watch, a repair or an appraisal? Send us a message and we reply within one working day.

sitemap.title: Site map
sitemap.intro: Every section of the Alberto Clocks website in one place.
